tasks.title: Add Broadcast Kinetic World Pack & Zero-Slop Showcase
tasks.prompt:
You are working on `Kyaa-A/nongeneric`, the Anti-Generic Designer & GSAP Motion Choreographer engine.

### CRITICAL ISOLATION RULES
1. ONLY create the 3 files listed below. Do NOT modify `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, or any existing files in `src/` or `scripts/`.
2. Do NOT use `innerHTML`, `outerHTML`, `document.write()`, or `eval()`.
3. Do NOT use banned AI-slop fonts (`Inter`, `Roboto`, `Open Sans`, `Lato`, `Montserrat`, `Poppins`, `Space Grotesk`), purple-to-blue gradients, `100vw`, `100vh` without `100dvh`, or `transition: all`.

### Files to Create
1. `packs/worlds/broadcast-kinetic.mjs`:
   - Export `BROADCAST_KINETIC_WORLD` conforming to the `AestheticWorld` shape (`id: 'broadcast-kinetic'`, `name`, `category: 'kinetic_typography'`, `era`, `summary`, `VisitorModes: ['immerse', 'convert']`, `References`, `Typography` using `'Barlow Condensed'` display + `'Chakra Petch'` body + `'JetBrains Mono'` mono, `Palette` with dark carbon/titanium OKLCH surfaces and broadcast signal-red/amber accents, `LayoutGrammar`, `SurfaceRules`, `MotionLanguage` with `'expo.out'` ease, `AntiHero`).
   - Export `compileBroadcastKineticCss()` returning a CSS `:root` string with the world's OKLCH tokens.
2. `examples/showcases/broadcast-kinetic.html`:
   - Self-contained HTML5 showcase demonstrating a high-velocity motorsport/esports broadcast telemetry deck using `Barlow Condensed`, `Chakra Petch`, and `JetBrains Mono`, `min-height: 100dvh`, fluid `clamp()` typography, tabular-nums leaderboard/telemetry splits, and reduced-motion-safe CSS (`@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`).
   - Must pass `scanTargets(['examples/showcases/broadcast-kinetic.html'])` from `../../scripts/detector.js` with `primaryCount === 0`.
3. `test/packs/broadcast-kinetic.test.js`:
   - Node `node:test` suite verifying `BROADCAST_KINETIC_WORLD` metadata, `compileBroadcastKineticCss()`, and asserting `scanTargets(['examples/showcases/broadcast-kinetic.html']).primaryCount === 0`.

Run `npm test`, `npm run check:generated`, `npm run check:json`, and `npm run typecheck` before finishing.
